description: This file implements an audio filter class 'AICFilter' using the ai-coustics AIC SDK for real-time audio enhancement within the Pipecat framework. It manages model initialization, parameter configuration, audio buffering, and processing, and provides methods for starting, stopping, and filtering audio streams.

classes.name: AICFilter
classes.description: A class implementing an audio filter using the ai-coustics AIC SDK for real-time audio enhancement, including model management, parameter setting, and audio processing.

methods.name: get_vad_factory
methods.description: Returns a factory function that creates a VoiceActivityDetector bound to the AIC model.

methods.name: create_vad_analyzer
methods.description: Returns a lazily-initialized AICVADAnalyzer with configurable lookback buffer size and sensitivity.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the AIC model with the given sample rate, setting parameters and logging info.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cleans up the AIC model and clears buffers.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable filtering and update parameters.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Buffers and processes incoming audio bytes, returning enhanced audio bytes.
